question: What triad is remembered in the petal-filament centers?
premises: In petal-filament centers is the sun-moon-fire triad.
It is presided by own lords Brahma, Vishnu, and Hara.
inference: The sun-moon-fire triad, presided by Brahma, Vishnu, and Hara, is remembered in the petal-filament centers.
uncertainties: The exact subtle-body location is implied.
plain_english: In the petal-filament centers, remember the sun-moon-fire triad, presided by its own lords Brahma, Vishnu, and Hara.
